title: scikit-learn pipelines: transformers, column selection and reproducibility

videos.script: A model is more than the model. {{more}} Medians, encoders, a scaler, seven columns from the last lesson. {{parts}} Done by hand, they work, until the model meets a new file. {{new}} In 2026 a monthly plan appears, and the hand-made model refuses it. {{refuses}} This lesson puts the preparation inside the model. {{inside}} One object, fitted once, used anywhere. {{object}} It can be tuned without leaking. {{tuned}} It can score a file it has never seen. {{score}} And it gives the same answer twice, which turns out to need a seed you might not know you needed. {{seed}} By the end, the churn model is a file other programs import. {{end}}
